--- ASIAN SESSION 15M STRUCTURE (Body Violation Analysis) ---
Use these 15M candles to evaluate Asian session setups after 21:00 NY Time:
- Identify the Asian session swing high and swing low from 19:00–21:00 candles.
- After 21:00, check if any 15M candle BODY (not wick) closes ABOVE the Asian swing high (BSL swept) or BELOW the Asian swing low (SSL swept).
- A body close above the Asian high = Buy-Side Liquidity swept = bearish reversal context.
- A body close below the Asian low  = Sell-Side Liquidity swept = bullish reversal context.
- Cross-reference with any 1H FVG or Note Breaker zones visible in the H1 data above.
